agent_note: Third-person retrospective narration across an ensemble (Franny, Teresa, Fix, Albie, Beverly); very strong past-tense evidence - 49 of 50 event quotes past, with plenty of unfakeable concrete past narration. Low gnomic share (6/76) compared with the other books in this batch. Two Russian-language quotes are translated-edition leakage -> paratext. The single present-tense event quote (q00799) is a self-contained lyric/visionary passage, not a narrating strand; it would not flip the label. Two quotes were called dialogue on register alone (1st person inside a 3rd-person book) because the source strips quotation marks.
